title: Case 022: Front Door Lock Repair Request
initial_request: Front door lock, the keys gets very hard to turn to unlock, thos sometimes leads to me standing at the door fiddling with the keys for a couple of minutes just so I can go outside.
overview: The tenant reported that the front door keys were difficult to turn, sometimes leaving them at the door for a couple of minutes. A maintenance provider was assigned and appointment arrangements were made. After some delay and follow-up, the repair was confirmed complete, including a lock change; the provider brought in a new key, which was added to the office key set and copied. The request was closed after checks were completed.
outcome: The contractor confirmed the work was complete, including replacement of the lock; the new key was then added to the office set and copied.
